solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Review various reports etc

indicators.note: various suggests the letters of the next words come in assorted, differing arrangements

explanation.surface: An instruction to go back over a pile of assorted reports and the like.
explanation.walkthrough: 'various' shuffles REPORTS plus ETC, all ten letters used.
explanation.definitionFit: A look back over past events is a review, so the noun and its synonym match.

clue.text: See report of journey here and there

indicators.note: a report is something heard, so the word it governs is to be taken by its sound

parts.note: to roam is to wander or journey here and there

explanation.surface: A travel writer's tip: read an account of wandering about.
explanation.walkthrough: 'See' looks like a verb meaning look; it is the Holy See, the Pope's seat in the Italian capital.
explanation.definitionFit: The Holy See, the papal government, is based in the Italian capital, so the city stands for it.

clue.text: 'Bitter zone' — name of hellish region

parts.note: tart means sharp or bitter in taste
a zone is an area

explanation.surface: A sourly named zone is put forward as the label for the underworld.
explanation.definitionFit: Tartarus is the hell of Greek myth; the adjective describes anything belonging to that infernal place.

clue.text: A lot become less severe when leader's gone

indicators.note: the leader of a word is its first letter, which here is removed

parts.note: to soften is to become milder or less severe

explanation.surface: Things ease off a great deal once the boss has departed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'when leader's gone' drops the S at the front of SOFTEN.
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something a lot means doing it frequently, a synonym for repeatedly.

clue.text: Dog may show the way ahead

definitions.meaning: a gun dog breed that stands still with nose aimed at game
an indicator such as a needle or arrow shows the direction to go

explanation.surface: A canine guide leading its owner on.
explanation.definitionFit: The gundog breed is named for aiming at game; any arrow or indicator also directs one forward.

clue.text: Part of church taking risk with Latin

parts.note: a chance is a risk or gamble

explanation.surface: A section of a church gambles on keeping its Latin services.
explanation.definitionFit: The area near the altar reserved for clergy and choir is one section of a church building.

clue.text: Block within this laboratory

indicators.note: within says the letters sit inside the run of words that follows

explanation.surface: Something blocked off inside a lab.
explanation.walkthrough: 'within' finds the letters straddling thiS LABoratory.
explanation.definitionFit: A thick flat piece of stone or concrete is a block, a near synonym.

clue.text: Nearly all botanical things go

indicators.note: nearly all of a word means it loses its final letter

parts.note: leaves are the green growths of plants

explanation.surface: Almost every plant item has gone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nearly all' trims the final S from LEAVES.
explanation.definitionFit: To depart or go away is a plain synonym for the verb here.

clue.text: Stigma I cast off and flourished

parts.note: a brand is a mark of disgrace, a stigma
to shed is to cast off, as skin or leaves

explanation.surface: Someone shook off a mark of shame and went on to thrive.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flourished' looks like 'thrived' but means waved about, as a sword is.
explanation.definitionFit: To flourish a weapon is to wave it about showily, the same as wielding it with a flourish.

clue.text: Join in tricks and puzzles

indicators.note: in places the joining word inside the word for tricks

parts.note: cons are tricks or swindles
to fuse is to join together

explanation.surface: Taking part in conjuring tricks and brain-teasers.
explanation.walkthrough: 'puzzles' looks like a noun but is the verb, meaning bewilders.
explanation.definitionFit: To puzzle someone is to bewilder them, a direct verb synonym.

clue.text: Weary male falling over in desert

indicators.note: in a down or across light, falling over means toppling backwards, so the letters run in reverse

parts.note: to tire is to weary

explanation.surface: An exhausted man collapses in the desert.
explanation.walkthrough: 'desert' is not sand but what one deserves, as in 'just deserts'.
explanation.definitionFit: Desert in the sense of what one deserves, as in just deserts, is worth or deservingness.

clue.text: Before long baddie will acquire a lover

parts.note: in a mo, short for in a moment, means before long
a rat is a nasty person, a baddie

explanation.surface: A warning that the villain will soon take a mistress.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian-derived word names a woman who is loved, a female sweetheart.

clue.text: Attractive space that's possessed by our planet?

definitions.text: Attractive space that's possessed by our planet?

parts.words: Attractive space that's possessed by our planet?
parts.note: the region around Earth in which a compass needle is pulled, attractive in the physical sense

explanation.surface: A tourist-brochure boast about a lovely stretch of land on Earth.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Attractive' reads as pretty but is literal: the zone where magnetism attracts.
explanation.definitionFit: Earth is surrounded by a region of magnetism that pulls on iron and compasses, literally an attracting zone.

clue.text: See 12
Man's crisis could come from such self-interest

indicators.note: says the letters of the earlier words may be rearranged to produce the result

parts.note: the word with its S kept as a letter of the fodder

explanation.surface: A man's emotional crisis might stem from being too wrapped up in himself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'could come from' rearranges MANS plus CRISIS; here the S of 'Man's' counts.
explanation.definitionFit: Excessive admiration of oneself, named after the youth in Greek myth enamoured of his reflection, is self-interest.

clue.text: Editor has the last word, having got article from Berlin

parts.note: amen is said at the end of a prayer, the final word
der is a German definite article

explanation.surface: An editor insists on the final say, having picked up a piece from Germany.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who makes changes and corrections to a text is an editor of sorts.

clue.text: Clamour before good fellow has good fight

parts.note: a din is a loud clamour
G again abbreviates good
a don is a university fellow
G again abbreviates good

explanation.surface: A noisy row ahead of a decent chap putting up a decent scrap.
explanation.walkthrough: A university don is a fellow of a college.
explanation.definitionFit: A hammer-and-tongs argument or brawl is informally called by this bell-sound name.

clue.text: The Parisian boys? You may get them in class

definitions.text: You may get them in class

parts.note: les is French for the (plural)
sons are boys

explanation.surface: French schoolboys, and what they receive in the classroom.
explanation.definitionFit: Periods of teaching are what pupils are given at school in class.

clue.text: Adjust attire, one being sloppy

indicators.note: something sloppy is careless and disordered, so the letters of the preceding words are jumbled

explanation.surface: Someone straightens their outfit because a person is looking scruffy.
explanation.definitionFit: To align or position things properly is to adjust them, a direct verb synonym.

clue.text: Orthodox minister in charge

parts.note: a canon is a member of the clergy, a minister

explanation.surface: A traditional clergyman is the one in command.
explanation.definitionFit: Conforming to the accepted rule or canon of a church means orthodox.

clue.text: Holiday accommodation, home containing old plant

parts.note: a camp is a holiday site, e.g. a holiday camp

indicators.note: containing says the word for home holds the next letter inside it

parts.note: in means at home

explanation.surface: A holiday cabin with an antique flower in it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' as at home, as in 'staying in'.
explanation.definitionFit: A wild flower of the pink family, common in British hedgerows, is a plant.

clue.text: Number going round estate briefly offering fun and gaiety

indicators.note: going round says the number word encircles the next piece

parts.note: five is a number
EST is the usual short form of estate

explanation.surface: A group of people touring a country estate in a jolly mood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Number' looks like a count of people; it is just FIVE.
explanation.definitionFit: Celebratory and merry describes a jolly occasion full of fun and gaiety.

clue.text: Never stopping, king is attacker

parts.note: for aye means forever, never stopping
R is the Latin abbreviation rex, king

explanation.surface: A tireless monarch is the aggressor.
explanation.definitionFit: A foray is a sudden raid, so one who makes one is a raider or attacker.

clue.text: Fast bowler who is a drug pusher?

definitions.meaning: in cricket, a bowler who relies on pace rather than spin
a dealer who trades in amphetamine

explanation.surface: Wondering whether a quick bowler is also a dealer.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket a fast bowler hurls the ball at pace; speed is also slang for amphetamine.
explanation.definitionFit: Cricket slang for a pace bowler; read literally it is a trader in the drug speed.

clue.text: We agreed to shut up this bore

indicators.note: to shut up is to enclose, so the letters are found enclosed within the words before it

explanation.surface: Everyone decided to silence this tedious person.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to shut up' encloses the letters of wE AGREEd; 'bore' is not a dull person but a tidal wave in a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A tidal wave surging up a river estuary, such as on the Severn or Trent, is a bore.

clue.text: See 22
After spring, paper's boss was optimistic

indicators.note: after puts the editor's letters behind the word for spring

parts.note: to hop is to spring or jump
ED is short for editor, the head of a newspaper

explanation.surface: Following a leap, the newspaper chief felt confident.
explanation.definitionFit: Wishing and expecting things to turn out well means being optimistic.

clue.text: Quiet group in conspiracy

parts.note: P is piano, the musical direction for quiet
a lot is a group or batch

explanation.surface: A hushed gang engaged in a secret scheme.
explanation.definitionFit: A secret scheme to do harm is a conspiracy, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Cleverness of northern native enemy ultimately concealing information

indicators.note: concealing says the earlier letters hide the word for information inside them

parts.note: the Inuit are native people of the Arctic north
gen is informal British slang for information

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word before it

explanation.surface: A clever Arctic native whose enemy finally hides intelligence.
explanation.walkthrough: GEN is British slang for information.
explanation.definitionFit: Inventive skill and cleverness are synonyms.

clue.text: Fruit left for girl

parts.note: a pear is a fruit

explanation.surface: Some fruit has been set aside for a young woman.
explanation.definitionFit: It is a girl's given name, so a girl may be called this.

clue.text: Suitable get-together

definitions.meaning: an old word for fitting or proper
a gathering, such as an athletics or hunting ...

explanation.surface: A fitting social gathering.
explanation.definitionFit: Archaic adjective for fitting or proper; as a noun, a sporting gathering or meeting.

clue.text: Contents of green tin I'd poured out as part of recipe

indicators.note: liquid poured out is scattered about, so the preceding letters are redistributed

parts.note: the apostrophe is ignored, leaving its two letters

explanation.surface: Emptying a tin of green stuff into a dish for a recipe.
explanation.walkthrough: 'poured out' rearranges GREEN, TIN and ID.
explanation.definitionFit: Each item that goes into a dish is one component of its recipe.
